problem_statement: The MAC header information element (HeaderIe) type needs support for dynamically building a variable-length IE inside a FrameBuilder: an API to begin appending an IE with a given element ID and record a bookmark of its start offset, then to finalize it by setting its length from the bytes appended since the start. The IE length must be capped at 127 bytes, and finalizing an IE whose payload would exceed that cap (128 or more bytes) must be rejected with an invalid-arguments error rather than silently corrupting the length field. A FrameBuilder must also be able to return a pointer to an object previously appended at a given byte offset so the IE descriptor can be located and updated. Without these, callers cannot build IEs whose content is appended after the descriptor.
